description: This file defines a Smarty template modifier function 'smarty_modifier_lookup' that takes a string value and an associative array, trims the string, and returns the corresponding value from the array if it exists, otherwise returns an empty string. It includes license and project attribution comments.

methods.name: smarty_modifier_lookup
methods.description: Function that trims the input value and looks up its corresponding value in the provided associative array, returning the value or an empty string if not found.
